parent: selective_depth_processing_v1; all initial event-budget outcomes retained
setting: Offline batch processing of already recorded RGB-D events; save depth-frame encoding work. No avoided sensor acquisition, camera purchase, or causal online-triggering claim.
event_cost: Number of distinct, actually evaluated frames in that event, between 1 and 12; no padded slots count as work. RGB frames are processed for all events. A depth choice processes every selected frame in that event.
allocation: Exact 0-1 knapsack maximises sum of predicted event absolute-error reductions under floor(cap*total depth frames in the batch). Nonpositive benefit need not consume budget. All events still receive an RGB or RGBD score.
training_targets: Group-leave-one-out RGB and RGBD predictions on training animals, with base hyperparameter identities fixed by inner validation; paired benefit=|y-RGB|-|y-RGBD|. In-sample benefit and shuffled benefit are controls.
gate: RGB kernel ridge with alpha [.01,.1,1,10,100] and training-median bandwidth multiplier [.5,1,2]; select by mean validation routing MAE at frame caps .25,.5,.75
primary_endpoint: Native-scale event MAE integrated over the declared frame-budget cap from 0 to1. Report actual realised frame counts separately; do not extrapolate a realised-cost curve beyond a method's attained cost.
controls: Ordinary predicted RGB error, posterior-style RGB kernel variance, nearest training distance, in-sample target, shuffled target, random affordable event order, and a labelled oracle diagnostic. Direct all-RGBD scoring remains a separate baseline even when the cap=1 policy leaves budget unused.
uncertainty: 10000 paired animal-group bootstrap resamples, holding fitted models fixed. Nominal intervals are exploratory and do not erase the preceding adaptive method search.
checks: All events scored; actual depth frames <= cap; zero-budget equals RGB base; saved scores reconstruct from gate decisions; knapsack objective checked against brute force for small cases; costs contain no padding; no test references in any deployable gate
scope: Single source, filename-derived identity groups; no independent external RGB-D cohort validates this gate yet. Dairy RGB-only data are not evidence of depth-routing validity.
